#!/bin/sh
set -eu

# Install beside Cargo.toml. App.Name is a complete shell-quoted argument,
# prepared separately from the TOML representation used by install/cargo.lu.
app_name='lucid_nested_rust'
project_dir=$(CDPATH= cd -P -- "$(dirname -- "$0")" && pwd -P)

case $(uname -s) in
    Darwin|Linux) ;;
    *) printf '%s\n' 'generated L applications support native macOS and Linux only' >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac

# Select the installed stable toolchain's native target explicitly. An inherited
# Cargo target setting must not turn this native launcher into a cross-build.
native_target=$(rustc +stable -vV | sed -n 's/^host: //p')
if [ -z "$native_target" ]; then
    printf '%s\n' 'could not determine the stable Rust native target' >&2
    exit 1
fi

cargo +stable build \
    --manifest-path "$project_dir/Cargo.toml" \
    --target-dir "$project_dir/target" \
    --target "$native_target" \
    --release \
    --bin "$app_name"

# The parent shell's CWD and standard streams are preserved. No service or
# background process is installed; the generated runtime owns its App children.
exec "$project_dir/target/$native_target/release/$app_name" "$@"
